He also shared a picture of his ideal studio, a room with ocean views and yoga mats near the water. Gina said she had lost her job at Door Dash that month. She described dance as her main stress relief and said that contemporary is her favorite style too. As a teenager, she had won first place at a regional competition at age fifteen with a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom." The two agreed to plan a dance session together, which was set for the following Friday.

On January 29, Gina said she had launched an ad campaign for her clothing store. Jon said he was still searching for a studio location and had found one downtown with good natural light. He also said he had been to Paris the day before, and Gina said she had only been to Rome once.
